seo_description: Dev tool that fixes broken Wwise integration after Perforce pulls. One click, all references restored.
hero.title: Wwise Unreal Engine Fixer
hero.subtitle: Dev Tool / Automation / Batch Script, Python GUI, Perforce Workflow
about.text: Every Perforce pull broke Wwise. Paths disappeared, actors went silent, we lost 20 minutes fixing it by hand each time. I wrote a tool that does it in one click. Scans the project, finds broken Wwise references, restores plugin settings, rebuilds configs. Auto-backup before any changes. Built with batch scripting and Python GUI. Tested on Shadow Frames with the whole team using Perforce.
how.title: How it works
how.scan_desc: Scans project files. Finds broken Wwise references in .uasset and config files.
how.fix_desc: Restores plugin settings. Updates configs. Rebuilds asset references. All automatic.
how.backup_desc: Backs up your project with a timestamp before making changes. Safe to use.
features.title: Features
features.logging_desc: Every file change is logged. Easy to see what happened.
features.precision_desc: Only touches Wwise-related files. Everything else stays untouched.
features.teams_desc: Tested on Shadow Frames (multi-person project with Perforce). Whole team uses it now.
